Applicants with a foreign university entrance qualification should apply directly to UniAssist.

notes: The intake dates (15 January - 15 October) are published in the 2026/2027 International Programmes edition of the DAAD page and on the current programme page; the pages do not state a year, so treat the year as provisional. For the German language requirement rule, the language is mapped to "fr" because Moroccan applicants (whose schooling is in French) are addressed; the quote itself names only German. The tuition quote about no fees is from this programme's own page and applies to the programme.
